de.body: SUMMARY Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building batch and streaming pipelines on GCP and Azure. At Yahoo, cut core pipeline cloud cost 94% (saving $150K+/month), maintained 50+ pipelines and 5B+ events/day at 99.9% SLA, and led an 8-engineer migration to Cloud Composer. Promoted to SDE II within 2 years. EXPERIENCE Yahoo - Software Development Engineer II Mar 2026 - Present • Led migration of 5 core event pipelines from Pig on Dataproc to 3 partitioned BigQuery SQL jobs, cutting cloud cost 94% ($161K to $9K/month) and runtime 85%; authored the design doc reused for later migrations. • Built a near real-time GA4 streaming pipeline on BigQuery and Airflow processing 4M views/hour at 10-minute freshness for $1.2K/month, used by 100+ dashboard users across 10+ Yahoo teams. • Diagnosed a data quality defect inflating engagement rate 28% for Yahoo News/Homepage and Yahoo Sports, tracing 884K phantom sessions to GA4 event logic and filtering them out in the content ETL. • Restored content attributes for 85% of real-time hourly views after an upstream source was retired; built, deployed, and validated a Apache Beam Dataflow fix that permanently moved enrichment to the new source. Yahoo - Software Development Engineer I Feb 2024 - Feb 2026 • Led a team of 8 engineers migrating batch workflows from on-prem Oozie and Kubernetes to GCP Cloud Composer, redesigning Oozie ETL workflows to scalable Airflow DAGs and cutting peak runtime 20%. • Maintained 50+ batch and streaming pipelines (Pub/Sub, Kafka, Storm; 5B+ events/day) at 99.9% SLA as on-call owner, integrating OpsGenie alerting with Airflow and cutting incident response time 50%. • Engineered BigQuery ML (ARIMA) anomaly detection across 30 content and video KPIs, catching 10+ anomalies in 3 months, including a homepage URL misroute fixed in 5 hours; design doc adopted by 2 teams. Yahoo - Software Engineer Intern May 2023 - Aug 2023 • Built a query benchmarking tool using a REST API to tag BigQuery jobs, with a UI to benchmark multiple date ranges storing runtime stats in Spanner, flagging 50 slow queries behind 7+ API endpoints. Honeywell - Software Development Engineer Oct 2020 - May 2022 • Engineered Spark/Databricks batch pipelines loading 100+ chemical plant params from PI Historian to Azure Data Lake at 70% lower latency, feeding Tableau and Power BI dashboards that cut resolution time 40%. • Developed AutoML and time-series ML models on process parameters that recommended optimal plant settings and predicted equipment failures, contributing to a 5% manufacturing throughput gain. PROJECTS Reliable FTP & P2P Sharing (C++, Linux, TCP/UDP): Built Go-Back-N ARQ over UDP with ACKs and retransmission; designed a TCP protocol with a multi-threaded server for concurrent peer lookups and transfers. CityByte (Python, Django, Linux, Multithreading): Designed a multi-threaded service with a thread pool for concurrent I/O-bound API requests and a thread-safe in-memory cache, cutting response latency 50%. Expertiza: Open-Source Peer Assessment (React, Ruby on Rails): Built React frontend and Ruby backend modules using object-oriented design patterns, improving maintainability and reducing code complexity. EDUCATION North Carolina State University (Master of Computer Science) GPA: 4.0/4.0 Aug 2022 - Dec 2023 Pune Institute of Computer Technology (B.E. in Computer) GPA: 8.99/10 Aug 2016 - May 2020

swe.body: SUMMARY Software engineer with 4+ years building high scale distributed systems on Linux and cloud in C++, Python and SQL. At Yahoo, re-architected core event processing to cut cloud cost 94% ($150K+/month), ran 50+ production services processing 5B+ events/day at a 99.9% SLA, and was promoted to SDE II within 2 years. EXPERIENCE Yahoo (Mountain View, CA) Software Development Engineer II Mar 2026 - Present • Re-architected 5 high-volume event pipelines from Pig on Dataproc into 3 partitioned BigQuery SQL jobs, cutting infrastructure cost 94% ($161K to $9K/month) and runtime 85% while improving scalability. • Designed a near real-time analytics pipeline (Python, SQL and Airflow) ingesting 4M events/hour at 10-minute freshness for $1.2K/month, serving 100+ dashboard users across 10+ teams. • Debugged a production defect in event-processing logic inflating engagement 28% for Yahoo News, Homepage and Sports, tracing 884K phantom sessions and shipping the fix. • Built, deployed and validated an Apache Beam (Dataflow) service change after an upstream source was retired, moving enrichment to the new source and restoring 85% of real-time attributes. • Built a Claude AI-agent workflow automating schema changes, cutting each change from 2 weeks to 2 days. Software Development Engineer I Feb 2024 - Feb 2026 • Led and mentored a team of 8 engineers migrating batch workloads from on-prem Oozie and Kubernetes to GCP Cloud Composer, redesigning 10+ workflows in Python with automated tests (pytest) and cutting peak runtime 20%. • Maintained 50+ distributed streaming services (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Storm) on Linux at 99.9% SLA as on-call owner, integrating OpsGenie monitoring and alerting, cutting incident response time 50%. • Engineered an ML (ARIMA) anomaly detection model across 30 content and video KPIs, catching 10+ anomalies in 3 months, including a URL change misrouting homepage views, fixed in 5 hours. • Redesigned classification logic for an audience measurement system, cutting uncategorized pageviews 92%. Software Development Engineer Intern May 2023 - Aug 2023 • Built a query benchmarking tool using a REST API to tag BigQuery jobs, with a UI to benchmark multiple date ranges storing runtime stats in Spanner, flagging 50 slow queries behind 7+ API endpoints. PROJECTS Simple FTP over UDP (C++, Linux): Built a reliable file transfer protocol with Go-Back-N ARQ, checksums, cumulative ACKs and retransmission; simulated packet loss and benchmarked delay vs window size and loss rate. P2P File Sharing over TCP sockets (C++/Python): Designed a custom request/response application layer protocol with a multi-threaded index server handling concurrent peer joins, lookups and peer-to-peer file transfers. CityByte (Python, Linux, Multithreading): Designed a multi-threaded service on Linux with a thread pool for concurrent I/O-bound API requests and a thread-safe in-memory cache, cutting response latency 50%. EDUCATION North Carolina State University (Master of Computer Science) GPA: 4.0/4.0 Aug 2022 - Dec 2023 Pune Institute of Computer Technology (BE in Computer Engg) GPA: 8.99/10 Aug 2016 - May 2020
